run_gpt2sw3_text_generation_test: run the integration test for gpt-sw3-126m text generation with custom sdpa and kv cache quantization
test_executorch_model_from_pretrained: test loading a gpt-sw3 model via ExecuTorchModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained with xnnpack recipe and 8da4w quantization
test_text_generation_with_kv_cache: test text generation using model.text_generation with a tokenizer prompt and max sequence length of 64
test_causal_lm_output_quality: test the causal LM output quality by checking generated tokens against the original model using check_causal_lm_output_quality
test_executorch_module_instance: test that the loaded model is an ExecuTorchModelForCausalLM and its inner model is an ExecuTorchModule
